crossRefs.note: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
When he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go out to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to…
Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.
as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John who was called Mark, where many were gathered…
Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John who was…
Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to…
Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received…
She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.
“I will heal their waywardness. I will love them freely; for my anger is turned away from him.
But many will be last who are first; and first who are last.
So the last will be first, and the first last. For many are called, but few are chosen.”
Behold, there are some who are last who will be first, and there are some who are first who will be last.”

people.name: Luke
people.line: Physician; companion of Paul; author of Luke and Acts

people.name: Mark
people.line: Cousin of Barnabas, companion of Paul, author of Gospel.

translations.web: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.
translations.bsb: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you, because he is useful to me in the ministry.
translations.kjv: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.
translations.asv: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee; for he is useful to me for ministering.
